name: TM17
description: The user is completely protected from attack in the turn it is used. It may fail if used in succession.

name: TM18
description: A heavy rain is summoned for five turns. Over that time, WATER-type moves are powered up.

name: TM19
description: The user strikes the foe with tentacles or roots, stealing the target's HP and healing itself.

name: TM20
description: Protects the party with a shield against all status problems over five turns.

name: TM21
description: This attack move grows more powerful the more the POKéMON dislikes its TRAINER.

name: TM22
description: A 2-turn attack that uses the first turn for absorbing sunlight, then blasting the foe in the next turn.

name: TM23
description: The foe is slammed with a sturdy tail of steel. It may lower the target's DEFENSE stat.

name: TM24
description: A massive jolt of electricity is launched at the foe. It may cause paralysis.

name: TM25
description: Strikes the foe with a huge thunderbolt. It may cause paralysis.

name: TM26
description: Causes an earthquake that strikes all POKéMON in battle, excluding the user.

name: TM27
description: This attack move grows more powerful the more the POKéMON likes its TRAINER.

name: TM28
description: A 2-turn attack in which the user digs underground, then strikes. It can be used to exit dungeons.

name: TM29
description: A powerful blast of telekinetic energy strikes the foe. It may lower the target's SP. DEF stat.

name: TM30
description: The foe is attacked with a shadowy lump. It may lower the target's SP. DEF stat.

name: TM31
description: Strikes the foe with a rock-hard fist, etc. It shatters barriers such as REFLECT and LIGHT SCREEN.

name: TM32
description: The user begins moving so quickly that it creates illusory copies to raise its evasiveness.

name: TM33
description: A tough barrier is put up over five turns. It reduces damage from physical attacks over that time.

name: TM34
description: A rapid jolt of electricity strikes the foe. This attack is impossible to evade.

name: TM35
description: The foe is roasted with a heavy blast of fire. It may leave the target with a burn.

name: TM36
description: Toxic sludge is hurled at the foe with great force. It may also poison the target.

name: TM37
description: Summons a sandstorm that lasts for five turns. It damages all types except ROCK, GROUND, and STEEL.

name: TM38
description: The foe is incinerated with an intense flame. It may leave the target with a burn.

name: TM39
description: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the target's SPEED stat if it hits.

name: TM40
description: An extremely fast attack against one target. It is impossible to evade.

name: TM41
description: If enraged by this move, the target becomes incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

name: TM42
description: An attack move that becomes very powerful if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

name: TM43
description: An attack move that may have an additional effect depending on the battle terrain.

name: TM44
description: A move that makes the user fall asleep over two turns to restore HP and heal any status problems.

name: TM45
description: The foe, if it is the opposite gender as the user, becomes infatuated and may not attack.

name: TM46
description: An attack that gives the user an opportunity to steal the foe's hold item.

name: TM47
description: The foe is struck with steel-hard wings. It may also raise the user's DEFENSE stat.

name: TM48
description: A special power is transmitted to the foe, causing it to switch abilities with the user.

name: TM49
description: A move that steals the effects of any status-changing or healing move that the foe tries to use.

name: TM50
description: A maximum-power attack of great ferocity, but one that also sharply reduces the user's SP. ATK stat.

name: HM01
description: Attacks the foe with sharp blades or claws. It can also cut down thin trees and grass outside of battle.

name: HM02
description: The user flies up on the first turn, then attacks next turn. It can be used to fly to any known town.

name: HM03
description: Creates a huge wave, then crashes it down on the foe. It can be used for traveling on water.

name: HM04
description: The user builds enormous power, then slams the foe. It can be used for moving large, round boulders.

name: HM05
description: Looses a powerful blast of light that reduces the foe's accuracy. It also lights up dark caves.

name: HM06
description: Hits the foe with a rock-crushingly tough attack. It can smash cracked boulders.

name: HM07
description: A powerful charge attack. It can be used for climbing a torrential waterfall.

name: HM08
description: A 2-turn attack in which the user dives underwater on the first turn, then strikes in the next turn.

name: OAK'S PARCEL
description: A parcel to be delivered to PROF. OAK from VIRIDIAN CITY's POKéMON MART.

name: POKé FLUTE
description: A flute that is said to instantly awaken any POKéMON. It has a lovely tone.

name: SECRET KEY
description: The key to CINNABAR ISLAND GYM's front door. It is colored red and decorated.

name: BIKE VOUCHER
description: Take this voucher to the BIKE SHOP in CERULEAN CITY and exchange it for a bicycle.

name: GOLD TEETH
description: A set of false teeth lost by the SAFARI ZONE'S WARDEN. It makes his smile sparkle.

name: OLD AMBER
description: A piece of amber that contains the genes of an ancient POKéMON. It is clear with a reddish tint.

name: CARD KEY
description: A card-type key that unlocks doors in SILPH CO.'s HEAD OFFICE in SAFFRON CITY.

name: LIFT KEY
description: A key that operates the elevator in TEAM ROCKET's HIDEOUT. It bears the TEAM ROCKET logo.

name: HELIX FOSSIL
description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling POKéMON. It appears to be part of a seashell.

name: DOME FOSSIL
description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling POKéMON. It appears to be part of a shell.

name: SILPH SCOPE
description: A scope that makes unseeable POKéMON visible. It is made by SILPH CO.

name: BICYCLE
description: A folding bicycle that allows faster movement than the RUNNING SHOES.

name: TOWN MAP
description: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.

name: VS SEEKER
description: A device that indicates TRAINERS who want to battle. The battery charges while traveling.

name: FAME CHECKER
description: A device that enables you to recall what you've heard and seen about famous people.

name: TM CASE
description: A case that holds TMs and HMs. It is attached to the BAG's compartment for important items.

name: BERRY POUCH
description: A pouch for carrying BERRIES. It is attached to the BAG's compartment for important items.

name: TEACHY TV
description: A television set that is tuned to a program with useful tips for novice TRAINERS.

name: TRI-PASS
description: A pass for ferries between ONE, TWO, and THREE ISLAND. It has a drawing of three islands.

name: RAINBOW PASS
description: A pass for ferries between VERMILION and the SEVII ISLANDS. It features a drawing of a rainbow.

name: TEA
description: An aromatic tea prepared by an old lady. It will slake even the worst thirst.

name: MYSTICTICKET
description: A ticket required to board the ship to NAVEL ROCK. It glows with a mystic light.

name: AURORATICKET
description: A ticket required to board the ship to BIRTH ISLAND. It glows beautifully.

name: POWDER JAR
description: A jar for storing BERRY POWDER made using a BERRY CRUSHER.

name: RUBY
description: An exquisitely beautiful gem that has a red glow. It symbolizes passion.

name: SAPPHIRE
description: An exquisitely beautiful gem that has a blue glow. It symbolizes honesty.
